error[L0301]: a distinct type has `==`, `<>` and its base's order, and `&`, `^`, `|` and `~` when its base is an unsigned integer; extract the base for anything else
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-equality-only/main.ldn:25:7
   |
25 |     d |= more
   |       ^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-equality-only/main.ldn:25:5
   |
25 |     d |= more
   |     ^^^^^^^^^ here
  = note: [0650]: arithmetic and shifts are the base's, written `base(value)`, and `&=`, `^=` and `|=` combine flags in place
error[L0301]: a comparison takes scalars, atoms, pointers and function values, not a distinct type whose base has no equality
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-equality-only/main.ldn:29:13
   |
29 |     equal = a == b
   |             ^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/distinct-equality-only/main.ldn:29:13
   |
29 |     equal = a == b
   |             ^^^^^^ the comparison here
  = note: [1890]: `==` and its kin compare one register-sized value; a view or an aggregate has no equality of its own
